latin: Per necessitatis regnum in Symposio Platonis, nihil aliud intelligere debemus quam superabundantiam naturae alterius supra naturam eiusdem, et infiniti supra terminum.
translation: The 'rule of necessity' spoken of in Plato's Symposium points to just one thing: how far the nature of the Other outstrips the nature of the Same, and the infinite outstrips limit.
